_comment: Sample index served from this repository. install.bundled lets the packaged gallery install the starter widgets without network access. The `requires` field is a display-only gallery badge for widgets that need an external CLI/runtime. `category` is an optional curated grouping surfaced as gallery filter chips (falls back to `tags`). `screenshot` renders a preview thumbnail and `readme` links a rendered Markdown details page.
name: barshelf official registry

widgets.name: Today
widgets.description: Native Calendar/Clock-style date widget with a large day number — the layout adapts to the widget size (small / medium / large) like a native iOS/macOS widget. No external dependency.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Recent Files
widgets.description: Stashbar-style recent files with a Grid/List view toggle and adjustable thumbnail size. QuickLook thumbnails that drag out to Finder/apps and open on click. Inspired by https://github.com/jiunbae/stashbar.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Stashbar Recent Files
widgets.description: Recent files from a folder you choose, in three view modes — Preview (a hero card for the newest file), Grid (thumbnail tiles), and a searchable List. QuickLook thumbnails, click to open, drag straight out to other apps. The official widget bundled with the native Stashbar app.
widgets.author: jiunbae

widgets.name: Battery
widgets.description: Battery level, charging state and power source from one pmset read: a big percentage, a level-colored meter, time left, and an opt-in low-battery alert. Says “No battery” on a Mac without one. Pure workflow, no Deno.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: aas Usage
widgets.description: LLM account usage from `aas usage --json` — per-account cards with plan badges (Max/Pro/Team) and two-column meters: a large health-colored remaining %, the actual time until each window resets, and a usage bar. Built on the native aas adapter.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: aas Alerts
widgets.description: Notifies once when any aas account runs low (default 20% left) and once when every account reports plenty again after a reset. A small opt-in companion to aas Usage, built on workflow alerts.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: tend Watch
widgets.description: Watch every tend agent from the menu bar — one native two-line row per agent with a colored state dot, its last activity, and the prompt it is working on, plus a load badge and an in-flight subagent tree when an agent fans work out. Add one card per host: local or SSH.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: OTP Codes
widgets.description: One-time password codes straight from your OTPeek vault with a countdown ring and one-tap copy — see https://github.com/jiunbae/otpeek. Requires the otpeek CLI and a configured vault (the vault password is read from the macOS Keychain).
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Codex Reset
widgets.description: Unofficial forecast of a Codex quota reset in the next 48 hours, from willcodexquotareset.com — a 0-100 chance mirrored into the menu bar, with an optional notification when it reaches your threshold (70% by default).
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Downloads
widgets.description: What arrived in a folder (Downloads by default) since you last marked it as seen, with the newest files as thumbnails to open, drag or reveal in Finder. Watches the folder, and the menu bar can show the new-file count.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: GitHub Status
widgets.description: GitHub's status page over HTTPS: the overall state, every unresolved incident, a menu bar item tinted only during an incident, and an opt-in incident notification.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: Native digital clock — a big HH:MM (24- or 12-hour) and the date in the app's language. Runs no commands.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: System
widgets.description: Native system monitor — CPU, memory and disk as health-colored meters, read straight from Mach with no subprocess. Choose what the menu bar shows — CPU total, user, system or busiest core; memory, pressure or swap; disk used, free, or read and write speed — and optionally a second reading beside it.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Sensors
widgets.description: Hardware temperatures, fans and power draw from the SMC, with the Apple Silicon HID sensor plane as a fallback. Choose a temperature, any single sensor, power draw, fan speed, or fan load for the menu bar — or two of them — in °C or °F where applicable.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.description: Native weather widget over a free HTTPS API (open-meteo, no key) — a big temperature and a condition icon for any latitude/longitude. Demonstrates the HTTP source.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Calendar
widgets.description: Native month calendar grid with today highlighted, computed without any command; moves to the new day at midnight and on wake.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Exchange
widgets.description: Exchange rate for any pair of twelve major currencies over a free HTTPS API (open.er-api.com, no key) — a big, comma-grouped rate that can sit in the menu bar.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Network
widgets.description: Native upload and download activity with optional live speeds, local address, and an interface selector. No subprocess or external dependency.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Stock
widgets.description: Live stock quote (any Yahoo Finance ticker) — a big price in its currency with the day's change and percentage, tinted up/down in the menu bar. Says so when a ticker is unknown or you're offline.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Now Playing
widgets.description: The current track from Music or Spotify. Requires macOS Automation permission — approve the one-time prompt so BarShelf can read Now Playing.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Reminders
widgets.description: How many open (incomplete) reminders you have. Requires macOS Automation permission for the Reminders app — approve the one-time prompt.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Next Meeting
widgets.description: Your next macOS Calendar event with time remaining, location, and a one-click Join button for Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, and other meeting links.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Quick Shelf
widgets.description: A searchable, permission-free launcher for frequently used apps, folders, and websites, with three customizable favorites.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Project Status
widgets.description: A glanceable Git repository dashboard: branch, working-tree changes, ahead/behind state, latest commit, Finder, and remote links.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Focus Timer
widgets.description: A persistent focus countdown with Start, Pause, Resume, Reset, a native live ring, completed-session count, and macOS notification.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Clipboard Shelf
widgets.description: A privacy-first clipboard history that keeps collecting every 5 seconds while the popup is closed (optional), with search, re-copy, pin, delete, secret detection and redacted caching. Only pinned items are kept on disk.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Developer Inbox
widgets.description: GitHub review requests and unread notifications in one private, actionable inbox with dedicated setup, empty, and partial-failure states.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Keep Awake
widgets.description: Keep the Mac awake for 1, 2 or 4 hours or until a set time — never indefinitely — and see what else is keeping it awake. Works with PowerDisplayGuard, which owns the power policy; BarShelf only asks.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Bluetooth Battery
widgets.description: Battery levels of connected Bluetooth devices — AirPods left/right/case, Magic Mouse, Keyboard and Trackpad — with meters, the lowest level in the menu bar, and an alert when one runs low.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Listening Ports
widgets.description: Local TCP listeners sorted by port — process, pid, and whether each is loopback-only or open to the network — with search, copy and open-in-browser.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Internet Quality
widgets.description: Latency, jitter and packet loss every few minutes from a light ping (almost no data), plus a capped 10-second speed test (download, upload, responsiveness) once a day, every 6 hours or only on demand. Notifies when the connection drops or turns unstable.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Homebrew Updates
widgets.description: Outdated Homebrew formulae and casks with installed → current versions, a count for the menu bar, a one-click copy of the upgrade command, and an optional notification when updates appear.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Quick Note
widgets.description: A short note on your shelf, with an optional heading and a copy button; promote it to the menu bar to keep a reminder in view.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: GitHub Actions
widgets.description: Recent GitHub Actions runs for a repository you choose, with status colors; click a run to open it. The menu bar shows the watched branch's latest result, with optional notifications when it starts failing and when it passes again. Tells you when gh is missing or signed out.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Site Monitor
widgets.description: Checks one http(s) URL with curl: up or down, response time, and why it failed. The menu bar shows milliseconds or "down", with notifications when the site goes down and when it recovers (and, optionally, when it gets slow). A Mac that is itself offline is not counted as down.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Docker
widgets.description: Running containers (optionally stopped ones too) with image, status and ports from the Docker CLI; works with Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima or Rancher Desktop. The menu bar can show the running count.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Tailscale
widgets.description: Tailscale connection state, this Mac's address, the exit node in use, and every device in your tailnet with OS and last seen. The menu bar shows on or off, with an optional notification when Tailscale disconnects.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Kubernetes
widgets.description: The pods of a kubectl context (yours or one you set) in one namespace or all of them: phase counts, ready count, and every pod that isn't ready with its reason and restarts. Lapsed cluster credentials, a missing kubectl or an unreachable cluster read as a short message with the fix. Optional notification when pods stay not ready past a grace period.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Bitwarden
widgets.description: Unlock your Bitwarden vault from the card, search items and copy a username, password or verification code (cleared from the clipboard after 30 s). BarShelf's built-in provider keeps only the session, in memory, and locks after 10 minutes without use, an hour at most, on screen lock and sleep. Tick Touch ID once and it reopens with your finger for 8 hours. Sign out of BarShelf's Bitwarden sign-in from the card. Also shows lock state and last sync.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: World Clock
widgets.description: Local time in up to five cities, with the day offset, the hour difference and dimmed rows outside working hours.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Countdown
widgets.description: A D-day counter for one or two dates: D-12, D-day or D+3 in big type, the date and the days left, with a notification on the day and, optionally, some days before.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Air Quality
widgets.description: PM2.5 and PM10 for any latitude/longitude from Open-Meteo (no key), graded on the Korean scale, with US/EU AQI and a notification when PM2.5 gets bad.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Crypto
widgets.description: Coin prices and 24-hour change from CoinGecko's public API (no key) in USD, KRW, EUR, JPY or GBP, with an optional 7-day chart; one coin can sit in the menu bar.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Hacker News
widgets.description: Hacker News through the public Algolia API (no key): the front page, Show HN or Ask HN, with a minimum-points filter; a row opens the story, the bubble opens the discussion.
widgets.author: barshelf

widgets.name: Break Reminder
widgets.description: Reminds you to stand up and rest your eyes every N minutes with a notification; a live ring counts down, with Took a break, Snooze and Pause/Resume.
widgets.author: barshelf

packs.name: Everyday
packs.description: The date, the weather and air quality, other cities' time, a countdown, your next meeting and your reminders.

packs.name: System
packs.description: CPU, memory, temperatures, network, battery and your Bluetooth devices, ready for the menu bar.

packs.name: Developer
packs.description: CI runs, a site you watch, open ports, Homebrew updates, agent usage and the inbox that needs you. Some need their own CLI.

packs.name: Files
packs.description: What just arrived in Downloads, recent files, and a shelf to drop things on.

packs.name: Infrastructure
packs.description: Your tailnet, containers, a Kubernetes namespace and your password vault's sync. Each needs its own CLI.
